actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT 
  sr.uuid as service_rate_uuid,
  sr.service_name,
  sr.base_fee as amount,
  sr.currency,
  sr.duration_terms,
  sr.estimated_days,
  -- The label: the two tiers in English as before, any other service by the name the office
  -- gave it in the merchant box (TODO 50, 2026-10-11 - TheBasket's "Кауфланд").
  CASE 
    WHEN sr.service_name LIKE '%-express' THEN 'Express Delivery'
    WHEN sr.service_name LIKE '%-standard' THEN 'Standard Delivery'
    ELSE COALESCE(svc.name, SUBSTRING(sr.service_name, CHAR_LENGTH(c.email) + 2))
  END as display_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN sr.service_name LIKE '%-express' THEN '⚡'
    WHEN sr.service_name LIKE '%-standard' THEN '📦'
    ELSE '🚚'
  END as icon,
  CASE 
    WHEN sr.service_name LIKE '%-express' THEN CONCAT('Express delivery in ', sr.estimated_days, ' day(s)')
    WHEN sr.service_name LIKE '%-standard' THEN CONCAT('Standard delivery in ', sr.estimated_days, ' day(s)')
    ELSE CONCAT('Delivery in ', sr.estimated_days, ' day(s)')
  END as description
FROM service_rates sr
JOIN contacts c ON c.uuid = '{{appsmith.store.customer_uuid}}'
-- The merchant's own services, saved from the console box: one row per service.
LEFT JOIN appsmith_portal_settings st ON st.`key` = CONCAT('fulfilya.services.', c.uuid) AND JSON_VALID(st.value)
LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(COALESCE(st.value, '{}'), '$.services[*]' COLUMNS (svc_key VARCHAR(64) CHARSET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$.key', name VARCHAR(80) CHARSET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$.name')) svc
  ON sr.service_name = CONCAT(c.email, '-', svc.svc_key)
WHERE sr.company_uuid = c.company_uuid
  AND sr.deleted_at IS NULL
  -- No service_type filter. The rates are matched by NAME, which carries the merchant's
  -- email - the same rule the backend uses (OrderWebhookService::findServiceRate). The old
  -- condition service_type = 'e-commerce-with-cod' emptied this dropdown for every merchant
  -- once the rates were recreated as 'parcel' on 2026-09-14 (found 2026-09-16).
  -- A third service counts only while the box lists it (TODO 50).
  AND (
    sr.service_name = CONCAT(c.email, '-standard')
    OR sr.service_name = CONCAT(c.email, '-express')
    OR svc.svc_key IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN sr.service_name LIKE '%-standard' THEN 1
    WHEN sr.service_name LIKE '%-express' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  sr.estimated_days ASC, 
  sr.base_fee ASC;
